name: פָּלָל
summary: Palal son of Uzai, who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem opposite the angle and the tower of the king's upper house, in the days of Nehemiah (Neh 3:25). The name has the consonants of the verb פָּלַל, whose piel is to arbitrate or intervene (1Sa 2:25); scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “פָּלָל son of Uzai, opposite the angle and the tower that projects from the upper house of the king.”
“If a man sins against a man, God פִּלְלוֹ”: the verb the name is read from.

note: Takes q.bq.ac (1 token). Whether the form is a noun “judge” or the verb “he has judged” is not decided; no verse explains it.
